# A coding agent outside our repositories gets neo in one command

Terminal predicate: A coding agent with no neo or Brain checkout runs one command and reaches a built, running neo app that it can reopen. The neo skills, the Neural Link and the engine's docs are all in place, and one cold run proves it, with no extra setup step recorded beyond harness consent.

## Problem scope

Graduated from D#20113 (revision 2; Signal Ledger below). A stranger's coding agent asked to build on neo gets almost nothing today. Receipts at `dev`, 2026-10-26:
- **Scaffold:** `npx neo-app` (13.3.1) writes no `AGENTS.md`, no MCP config, no skills and no `useAiClient`.
- **Skills:** `neo-agent-skills` reaches only our own repositories. It is an engine devDependency, and a registry install never runs `prepare` (`buildScripts/util/prepare.mjs`). The materializer projects every skill, and `.agents/skills` is a single directory link with no audience filter.
- **Neural Link:** the server runs only from a Brain checkout. `neo-agent-brain` is `private` and not on npm, and the server imports Brain modules plus an untracked `./config.mjs` overlay.
- **Registry:** the six `server.json` manifests carry no `packages` entry, so a client that finds them has nothing to install (`neo-agent-brain#1265`, post-merge).

**Why an epic:** the outcome needs coordinated work in four repositories, ordered by one published package. The skills audience has to be released before the scaffold can use it. The Neural Link package has to be live before any MCP config or registry entry can point at it. And the operator's first npm publish sits between them.

## Intended solution shape

Selected in D#20113: E1 + N1 + S1 + D1.
- **Scaffold (E1):** `neo-app` writes an agent layer into every new workspace. `--agent` adds it to an existing workspace and `--no-agent` skips it. The layer is the `app` `AGENTS.md`, a `CLAUDE.md` importing it, the `app` skills materialized by the workspace's own `prepare`, `useAiClient: 'development'`, and project-level MCP configs once the package is live.
- **Skills (S1):** the skills declare an audience. Under a declared audience the materializer links both harness surfaces per skill, and the generator emits an `app` `AGENTS.md`. The v1 `app` set is `neural-link` and a new `neo-app-authoring`. The audience is declared, never inferred.
- **Neural Link (N1):** the Neural Link runs from its own npm package (`mcpName` `io.github.neomjs/neural-link`).
  - Its launcher declares a standalone placement (`~/.neo-ai/neural-link`) by env before the server starts. That is a new ADR-0019 §10.7 row, mirroring the packaged Fleet Manager's own mode.
  - It passes the package root as `--cwd`, so the existing Bridge auto-spawn and its refusals run unchanged.
  - The config overlays are materialized at pack time.
- **Docs (D1):** `AGENTS.md` and the skills point at `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt` and `/raw/**` on neomjs.com.
- **Registry:** `neural-link` gets its `packages` entry. The other five manifests stay unpublished until a client can run them.

## Decision Record

Required: `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#adr:0019-aiconfig-reactive-provider-ssot`, §10.7 gains the standalone profile row in or before the Brain leaf's PR.

Decision Record impact: amends `neomjs/neo-agent-brain#adr:0019-aiconfig-reactive-provider-ssot` (through the Brain leaf).

## Discussion Criteria Mapping

- OQ1 `[RESOLVED_TO_AC]` → the Brain leaf: standalone root `~/.neo-ai/neural-link`, and `memoryCoreDbPathProd` keeps its derived default.
- OQ2 `[RESOLVED_TO_AC]` → the Brain leaf: the launcher passes the package root as `--cwd`; no `ConnectionService` change.
- OQ3 `[RESOLVED_TO_AC]` → the skills leaf: `neural-link` and `neo-app-authoring`.
- OQ4 `[RESOLVED_TO_AC]` → the scaffold leaves: project-level configs only, with harness consent recorded apart from setup steps in the cold run.
- OQ5 `[RESOLVED_TO_AC]` → the Brain leaf: the package is `neo-neural-link`, free on npm. The operator delegated the choice (2026-10-26: "equal peer stands. if you want a specific package name, and it is free, ok."). The first npm publish stays his, because it is his account.
- STEP_BACK consumer partial → the skills leaf: per-skill `.agents/skills` links under a declared audience.

## Out of scope

- A hosted read-only Knowledge Base (D2): its own design, as a `remotes` entry.
- Registry entries for `file-system`, `github-workflow`, `gitlab-workflow`, `knowledge-base` and `memory-core`.
- Harness configs beyond Claude Code and Codex. `AGENTS.md` and the registry reach other clients.
- Contributor onboarding into our own repositories (`#14230`), and the Workstation stranger journey (`#14781`).

## Avoided traps

- Publishing the whole Brain (N2), or a git dependency on it (N3): either one installs every Brain dependency, native ones included, on each cold run.
- Static copies of skills in the scaffold (S3): they drift from the SSOT.
- Inferring the audience from the consumer repository, or the plane profile from where the code lives: both are hidden defaults. Audiences are declared, and ADR-0019 §10.8 has roles declared, never inherited.
- Spawning a co-located Bridge when `cwd` is omitted: it brings back the default `spawnBridge` refuses on purpose.

The run used a fresh directory, a fresh HOME and a fresh npm cache:
1. **One command:** `npx -y neo-app@13.3.2 -w ws -n MyApp -t all -u no -s false` (prompt defaults passed as flags) exited 0 in 55 s, build included. The workspace holds `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.mcp.json` and `.codex/config.toml`, plus `neo-app-authoring` and `neural-link` under both `.claude/skills` and `.agents/skills` (`neo-agent-skills@0.1.61`). ### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-10-26T15:54:11Z

**Cloud cold walk (2026-10-26): end-to-end works on a machine with nothing of ours on it. The predicate's "no extra setup step" is not met yet.**

The operator ran a Claude Code cloud session (environment `neo-app`, Full network, started on `neomjs/create-app` and left unchanged) with an outside-developer brief. The agent used only `/tmp/neo-walk/node_modules`.

What worked:
- `npx neo-app` built the workspace in 131.7 s (npm install 58 s, buildAll 60 s).
- The dev server came up, a headless page was visible in 0.92 s, and the workspace's own `npx -y neo-neural-link` initialized in 12.3 s with 60 tools.
- `get_component_tree` returned `MyApp.view.Viewport` → `Neo.tab.Container` → toolbar (2 buttons), strip, body (2 components).
- **Reopen:** after a page reload and after a dev-server restart, the tree came back identical. A reload reconnects in about 0.5 s; tool calls take 2–15 ms.

Steps beyond the one command, and where each is owned:

| Step (the agent's label) | Cause | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Finding the port, `--no-open`, the URL (setup) | `AGENTS.md` silent | neomjs/create-app#51 |
| `.mcp.json` not loaded as a tool (environment) | the harness loads it only from the session's start folder | neomjs/create-app#51 (start in the workspace) |
| First `get_component_tree` failed: "No active App Worker sessions found" while `healthcheck` said healthy with 0 sessions (setup) | the page loaded before the Bridge; the client stops dialing after about 17 s by design (`Client#redial`, "never on a timer") | neomjs/create-app#51 + neomjs/neo-agent-skills#215 (document the reload rule) |
| Playwright browser missing (setup) | needs `npx playwright install chromium` | neomjs/create-app#51 |
| `simulate_event` had no `windowId` | **engine bug**: a window is never announced when the socket opens before the app registers | neomjs/neo#20129 |
| Wrong `get_dom_rect` parameter | compact tool list, and nothing points to `get_mcp_tool_handbook` | neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1303 + neomjs/neo-agent-skills#215 |
| Processes left running, port 8081 held | `manage_connection stop` kills only the detached npm wrapper; the server does not exit when its client leaves | neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1302 |
| Skills say "MUST use `view_file`" | a maintainer harness tool name | neomjs/neo-agent-skills#215 |

**Consent** did not occur in this run, because the server was started by hand. In a normal setup it is one approval of the project `.mcp.json` server. The next walk should start the cloud session from a repo that already contains a workspace, so the harness loads `.mcp.json` at session start and that approval is observed.

**Noise, filed as defect-notes:**
- the dev server's development-theme warning, a false alarm in workspaces (it checks the theme folder inside `node_modules/neo.mjs`);
- `.git can't be found`, printed with its newline missing;
- 13 `npm audit` vulnerabilities from buildAll's temporary highlight.js clone;
- the `dist/esm` computed-import notice;
- a `/favicon.ico` 404;
- normal Neural Link startup lines that read as failures;
- `EBADENGINE` for Node ≥ 24 on every package, while the walk ran fine on Node 22.22.

The epic closes when those leaves land and a walk records only harness consent.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-10-26T16:07:02Z

**Addendum to the cloud walk: the cloud agent's verbatim log lines, pulled before the session closed.**

Two noise items have concrete causes and are now leaves:
- **`.git can't be found`.** The workspace's `postinstall` (`cd node_modules/neo.mjs && npm i …`) runs `neo.mjs`'s maintainer `prepare`, which runs husky and links 39 maintainer skills into the dependency. `prepare.mjs`'s `isDependencyBuild` misses this because `INIT_CWD` equals the package root → #20131.
- **The theme warning.** It prints no path. `createDevelopmentThemeFreshnessHooks` calls `inspect()` without arguments, so the check runs against `node_modules/neo.mjs/dist/development/css`; the "632 missing" figure came from the agent's own call of that same check. → #20132.

The other three remain defect-notes, now with exact text:
- **dist/esm notice:** `dist/esm/src/worker/Data.mjs → ../../examples/${e.slice(9)}.mjs (directory dist/esm/examples/ is absent)`. It is the engine's own build diagnostic hitting a branch a workspace never takes, so it is noise for consumers.
- **Neural Link cold start:**
  - Normal startup prints `[WARN] Disconnected from Neural Link Bridge (code=1006, reason=none)`, then `[INFO] Failed to connect to existing bridge: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:8081`, then `Assuming Bridge not running. Spawning new Bridge process...`, followed about 2 s later by `✅ [Startup] Neural Link health check passed`.

- **The scaffold's nested install** pulls `neo-agent-skills@0.1.56`, the engine's pin at 13.3.1, while the workspace links the app audience from 0.1.61.
